findings.current:
She was the leader of all the white-robed figures, and had served the Lord of Heaven even more closely than the Blood-Sword Demon Lord himself.

So even a born killer like him couldn’t easily lay a hand on her over a mere slight.
findings.defect: Reveals the figure is a woman before the source’s deliberate correction from “he” to “she.”
findings.rationale: The source withholds the figure’s gender until she speaks.
findings.replacement:
The figure led the white-robed group and had served the Lord of Heaven even more closely than the Blood-Sword Demon Lord himself.

So even a born killer like him couldn’t easily strike over a mere slight.
findings.source:
모든 백의인들의 우두머리 격인 동시에, 심지어 혈검마군 자신보다도 가까이에서 천주를 모셨던 자.

그러니 살귀(殺鬼)의 기질을 타고난 혈검마군으로서도 단순한 수틀림을 명분 삼아 쉽사리 손을 쓸 수 없었다.

findings.current: But neither the white-robed woman he’d singled out nor anyone around her answered.
findings.defect: Again identifies the figure as a woman before the reveal.
findings.rationale: The source still refers to the target as a white-robed figure here.
findings.replacement: But neither the white-robed figure he’d singled out nor anyone nearby answered.
findings.source: 하지만 표적이 된 백의인은 물론, 그를 둘러싼 누구도 혈검마군의 말에 대꾸하지 않았다.

findings.current: They’d been tipping fast even before the battle began. They were tipping even faster now.
findings.defect: Adds that the advantage is growing faster now than before.
findings.rationale: The source says the scales tip rapidly at both times, without comparing the rates.
findings.replacement: They had been tipping rapidly before the battle began, and they were still tipping rapidly now.
findings.source: 전투를 시작하기 전에도, 지금 이 순간에도 빠르게 기울고 있다.

findings.current: Why was she hurling a boulder into his heart, cracking the faith he’d so firmly believed was absolute trust?
findings.defect: Obscures whose trust is in doubt: he believed his master trusted him completely.
findings.rationale: The source describes his belief that he was receiving wholehearted trust.
findings.replacement: Why was she hurling a boulder into his heart, cracking his conviction that he had his master’s complete trust?
findings.source: 그저 전폭적인 신뢰를 받고 있다 굳게 믿었던 자신의 마음에, 어찌 이리 커다란 바위를 던져 균열을 일으키는 것일까.

findings.current: Before the roar even reached him, a wave of power suddenly washed over the Blood-Sword Demon Lord. He turned his head a moment ahead of it, took in the scene, and murmured calmly.
findings.defect: Says he turns before the wave reaches him, although sensing that wave prompts him to turn before the roar.
findings.rationale: The source makes the felt wave the cue for his early turn.
findings.replacement: Before the roar even reached him, the Blood-Sword Demon Lord sensed a sudden wave of power and turned his head. He took in the scene and murmured calmly.
findings.source: 그리고 굉음이 울려 퍼지기도 전, 불현듯 느껴지는 힘의 파동에 한발 앞서 고개를 돌린 혈검마군은 모든 것을 확인하고 담담하게 뇌까렸다.

findings.current: Eternal death had finally come for them, too.
findings.defect: Makes the Black Ghosts’ permanent deaths complete before the subsequent spear strike.
findings.rationale: 찾아오고 있다 describes death approaching, not having already arrived.
findings.replacement: Eternal death was finally coming for them, too.
findings.source: 그들에게도 마침내 영원한 죽음이 찾아오고 있다는 사실을.

findings.current: Not the four Black Ghosts. Not the followers who had kept charging at the two masters without pause.
findings.defect: Calls Jeok Cheongang and Jin Taekyung two masters, losing their master-disciple relationship.
findings.rationale: 두 사승 identifies the pair by their master-disciple relationship.
findings.replacement: Not the four Black Ghosts. Not the followers who had kept charging at the master and his disciple without pause.
findings.source: 끊임없이 두 사승을 향해 덤벼들던 교도들도.

summary: The draft reveals the white-robed figure’s gender before the source does and alters several battlefield details.
